name: Flatre
description: Connect Claude to your Flatre real estate workspace to find transactions, contacts, properties, tasks, approvals, document metadata, safe message previews, commission summaries, integration status, and recent workspace activity. Claude can also prepare internal tasks, notes, supported record-change proposals, and low-risk email drafts through Flatre Automation. Workspace permissions, OAuth scopes, deterministic safety checks, and approval requirements remain authoritative. Flatre does not expose raw email bodies, document contents, attachments, credentials, storage keys, or direct approval and deletion actions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flatre to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flatre to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.flatre.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flatre MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flatre lists 19 MCP tools, including create_internal_task, get_contact, get_integration_status, get_transaction, get_transaction_financial_summary, list_document_details, list_pending_approvals, list_tasks, propose_contact_update, propose_property_update, propose_transaction_update, and record_internal_note.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Flatre?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Flatre in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Flatre requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Flatre is developed by Flatre. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
